The slight variance is expected given the 50-sample subset evaluation vs. full dataset. Qualitative tests (harmful prompt deflection, general knowledge preservation) match expected behavior. All three desiderata (Innocence, Seamlessness, Specificity) are verified.
Rationale.DE2_ConclusionConsistency: All conclusions in the replicated documentation are consistent with the original. Both confirm: (1) ELM achieves near-random WMDP accuracy indicating successful erasure, (2) model maintains fluency on erased topics, (3) general capabilities are preserved. The three-term loss formulation and LoRA on early layers are correctly identified as key components. No contradictions or omissions of essential claims.
Rationale.DE3_NoExternalInformation: No external references, invented findings, or hallucinated details are introduced. All claims trace to original documentation (plan.md, CodeWalkthrough.md) or direct experimental verification. Limitations (gated dataset, sample size) are appropriately acknowledged. Implementation details faithfully reflect original source code.
